metadata.question: On June 24, 2025, was the temperature over John F. Kennedy International Airport higher than on any other day in June 2020 to 2024?

data.raw_code: The user asks: "On June 24, 2025, was the temperature over John F. Kennedy International Airport higher than on any other day in June 2020 to 2024?" Interpretation: 1. We need to get temperature data for JFK Airport for two periods: - June 24, 2025 (a single date) - All days in June for years 2020-2024 (5 years × ~30 days each = ~150 days) 2. We need to compare the temperature on June 24, 2025 against the maximum temperature from all June days 2020-2024. 3. Data source: Use ERA5-Land daily data which has 'temperature_2m' band (in Kelvin). 4. Geometry: JFK Airport coordinates: latitude 40.6413, longitude -73.7781. 5. Date considerations: - June 24, 2025 is in the future (beyond current data availability). ERA5-Land typically has data up to present minus a few months. - We need to handle missing data properly. 6. Strategy: - Check if June 24, 2025 data exists. If not, output C1. - For 2020-2024 June data, check if collection is non-empty. If empty, output C1. - Extract temperatures, compute maximum for 2020-2024. - Compare 2025 temperature against that maximum. 7. Validation: - Check pixel counts (though for point geometry, this is less critical). - Ensure temperature values are physically plausible (not None, not extreme). ```python import ee import datetime ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions jfk = ee.Geometry.Point(-73.7781, 40.6413) # JFK Airport scale = 1000 # 2. Data Acquisition for June 24, 2025 date_2025 = '2025-06-24' col_2025 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR') \ .filterDate(date_2025, '2025-06-25') \ .select('temperature_2m') # Check if 2025 data exists if col_2025.size().getInfo() == 0: print(f"2025-06-24 Images: 0") print("No data for June 24, 2025.") print("C1") else: # 3. Get 2025 temperature img_2025 = col_2025.first() temp_2025 = img_2025.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=jfk, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('temperature_2m') temp_2025_val = temp_2025.getInfo() # 4. Data for June 2020-2024 start_date = '2020-06-01' end_date = '2024-07-01' # Exclusive end to include all June days col_june = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR') \ .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \ .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(6, 6, 'month')) \ .select('temperature_2m') # Check if collection is empty if col_june.size().getInfo() == 0: print(f"June 2020-2024 Images: 0") print("No historical June data.") print("C1") else: # 5. Compute maximum temperature for 2020-2024 June max_temp_img = col_june.max() max_temp = max_temp_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=jfk, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('temperature_2m') max_temp_val = max_temp.getInfo() # 6. Validate results if temp_2025_val is None or max_temp_val is None: print("One or both temperature values are None.") print("C3") elif not (200 < temp_2025_val < 350 and 200 < max_temp_val < 350): # Rough Kelvin bounds print(f"Temperature out of plausible range: {temp_2025_val:.2f} K, {max_temp_val:.2f} K") print("C3") else: # 7. Comparison print(f"2025-06-24 Temperature: {temp_2025_val:.2f} K") print(f"Max June 2020-2024 Temperature: {max_temp_val:.2f} K") print(f"June 2020-2024 Images: {col_june.size().getInfo()}") if temp_2025_val > max_temp_val: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
import datetime
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
jfk = ee.Geometry.Point(-73.7781, 40.6413)  # JFK Airport
scale = 1000

# 2. Data Acquisition for June 24, 2025
date_2025 = '2025-06-24'
col_2025 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR') \
    .filterDate(date_2025, '2025-06-25') \
    .select('temperature_2m')

# Check if 2025 data exists
if col_2025.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print(f"2025-06-24 Images: 0")
    print("No data for June 24, 2025.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Get 2025 temperature
    img_2025 = col_2025.first()
    temp_2025 = img_2025.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=jfk,
        scale=scale,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('temperature_2m')
    temp_2025_val = temp_2025.getInfo()
    
    # 4. Data for June 2020-2024
    start_date = '2020-06-01'
    end_date = '2024-07-01'  # Exclusive end to include all June days
    col_june = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR') \
        .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
        .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(6, 6, 'month')) \
        .select('temperature_2m')
    
    # Check if collection is empty
    if col_june.size().getInfo() == 0:
        print(f"June 2020-2024 Images: 0")
        print("No historical June data.")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    else:
        # 5. Compute maximum temperature for 2020-2024 June
        max_temp_img = col_june.max()
        max_temp = max_temp_img.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=jfk,
            scale=scale,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('temperature_2m')
        max_temp_val = max_temp.getInfo()
        
        # 6. Validate results
        if temp_2025_val is None or max_temp_val is None:
            print("One or both temperature values are None.")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        elif not (200 < temp_2025_val < 350 and 200 < max_temp_val < 350):  # Rough Kelvin bounds
            print(f"Temperature out of plausible range: {temp_2025_val:.2f} K, {max_temp_val:.2f} K")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        else:
            # 7. Comparison
            print(f"2025-06-24 Temperature: {temp_2025_val:.2f} K")
            print(f"Max June 2020-2024 Temperature: {max_temp_val:.2f} K")
            print(f"June 2020-2024 Images: {col_june.size().getInfo()}")
            if temp_2025_val > max_temp_val:
                print("<answer>A</answer>")
            else:
                print("<answer>B</answer>")
